dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to make a cannon?

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Me? No, no, this cannon was designed by Mécantre and Babisse. I just had some... peripheral participation in the discussions.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Even though the design philosophy and purpose of this cannon are intriguing to say the least, I must say that this line of thinking is quite... well, overboard.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: A "daydream" in all senses of the word.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Putting aside the cannon material and the shape of the projectile it must fire, immense amounts of propellant must be expended to fire any shell up to the altitude they desire...

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Hehe, the fuel they'd need could stuff four or five cannons of this caliber to the brim.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: ...That said, I reckon it's not a bad thing that their research continues. My guidance may yet ensure that their work bears fruit that will be useful in other fields...
